tags.instructions: Use when you want the asynchronous Shopping source. Use `list-google-shopping-ads` for the immediate synchronous source. After receiving taskId, call `get-google-shopping-search` to check results. Starting again creates another task and may consume additional credits; do not retry an ambiguous start blindly.
